body_markdown:
Origin Bank announced today the opening of its new Mobile Financial Center, marking an important step in the bank’s continued investment in the Mobile community. Located at 119 W. I-65 Service Road N., the newly constructed Financial Center replaces Origin’s former location at 3700 Dauphin St., Suite B, and provides convenient access to the responsive, relationship-focused experience Origin is known for.


“The opening of this location is an exciting chapter of the Origin story in Mobile and Alabama,” said Nate Sommer, Southeast regional president at Origin Bank. “Since introducing the market to Origin Bank and establishing our temporary location in 2024, our team has been actively serving local families, businesses and community partners. We’re thrilled to welcome our clients to this beautiful new space and to continue expanding our services throughout the area.”


The new Financial Center is managed by Lorna Gurley and serves as the home base for Origin’s Mobile team, led by Mobile Market Leader, Steve Rockwell. With extensive experience in the banking industry and a strong commitment to serving the community, the Mobile team offers a broad range of financial services designed to meet the needs of individuals, families and businesses throughout the greater Mobile area.


“I’m incredibly proud of the team we’ve built in Mobile and even more excited about what’s ahead,” said Steve Rockwell, Mobile market leader at Origin Bank. “This new permanent location helps support the strong relationships we have established here and positions us to continue growing alongside our clients and community.”


Services available at the new location include:


- Personal and commercial banking
- Treasury management solutions
- Competitive deposit and lending options
- ATM services
- Drive-thru banking


Along with establishing a banking center in Fairhope and entering the Birmingham market earlier this year, Origin Bank continues to expand its footprint throughout Alabama to better meet the needs of local clients and communities. The Mobile Financial Center is located at 119 W. I-65 Service Road N., Mobile, Alabama, and is open in the lobby and drive-thru from 8:30AM – 4:30PM, Monday through Friday. To learn more, please visit origin.bank.


**About Origin**


Origin Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Ruston, Louisiana. Origin’s wholly owned bank subsidiary, Origin Bank, was founded in 1912 in Choudrant, Louisiana. Deeply rooted in Origin’s history is a culture committed to providing personalized relationship banking to businesses, municipalities, and personal clients to enrich the lives of the people in the communities it serves. Origin provides a broad range of financial services and currently operates more than 57 locations in Dallas/Fort Worth, East Texas, Houston, North Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and the Florida Panhandle. For more information, visit www.origin.bank. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender.
